officialPoIntegration.title: G-SYS Official PO Integration
officialPoIntegration.subtitle: Independent of Demo Send - foundation for future real G-SYS Integration (Phase 7-C2A).
officialPoIntegration.officialPoNoUnassignedNote: The numbering rule is unresolved CUSTOMER REVIEW, so no number is auto-assigned this Phase. This is not an error.
officialPoIntegration.requestDialogBody:
Creates an Integration Request and checks consistency against Legacy Master data (Preflight).
This does NOT register anything in G-SYS or submit any File.
officialPoIntegration.errorNotApproved: Only an APPROVED order can prepare G-SYS Integration.

preflightIssue.SUPPLIER_NOT_FOUND: Supplier code was not found in G-SYS.
preflightIssue.BRAND_NOT_FOUND: Brand code was not found in G-SYS.
preflightIssue.ITEM_NOT_FOUND: Item code was not found in G-SYS, or is discontinued.
preflightIssue.OFFICIAL_PO_NO_NOT_ASSIGNED: No Official PO No. is assigned yet, so existing PO/Invoice/Stock-in checks are deferred to a later Phase.

officialPoIntegration.officialPoNoHelperText: Up to 30 characters. No structure is enforced (numbering rule is unresolved CUSTOMER REVIEW).
officialPoIntegration.numberLockedNote: Already submitted to G-SYS - the PO No. and Excel details can no longer be changed.
officialPoIntegration.errorInvalidNumber: Official PO No. must be 1-30 characters.
officialPoIntegration.errorDuplicateNumber: This Official PO No. is already used by another order.
officialPoIntegration.errorAlreadySubmitted: Already submitted to G-SYS - this can no longer be changed.
officialPoIntegration.errorNumberRequired: Confirm the Official PO No. first.
officialPoIntegration.errorPreflightBlocked: The latest Preflight result is BLOCKED - resolve the issues and re-request first.
officialPoIntegration.placedNote: Already placed into the Import Folder - waiting for G-SYS to pick it up.

importConfirmReason.NOT_YET_IMPORTED: G-SYS has not registered this Official PO yet. This is not an error - the Batch may simply not have run yet. You can check again later.
importConfirmReason.MISMATCH: G-SYS has registered this Official PO No., but its line items don't match the current Order.

officialPoIntegration.importConfirmedNote: Confirmed: G-SYS's registered content matches this Order.
officialPoIntegration.errorNotSubmitted: This Order has not been placed into the Import Folder yet.

legacyPoConcurrency.title: G-SYS Consistency Check
legacyPoConcurrency.captureButton: Record Current G-SYS State As Baseline
legacyPoConcurrency.captureSuccess: Recorded the current G-SYS state as the Baseline.

followUp.title: Follow-up
followUp.createButtonTooltip: Records the content of a Supplier inquiry for this Order in the Portal (no real mail is ever sent). Can be created at any time, regardless of whether Official G-SYS PO integration exists or Fulfillment data can be retrieved.
followUp.skuHelperText: Leave blank for an Order-level inquiry.
followUp.reorderDialogBody: Creates a new Order Draft for this Case's SKU. Quantity is never auto-decided (Legacy Recommended Qty is the initial value).
